data.name: Athaal
data.gender_notes: Athaal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A lion, a symbol of courage, power and strength. The name Athaal carries the meaning “Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Athaal usually hope their child will grow to embody lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Athaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Athaal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: اثال
in_urdu.meaning: منصب و جاہ و مقام والا، شریف و منزلت دار
in_urdu.long_meaning: اثال (Athaal) ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے منصب و جاہ و مقام والا، شریف و منزلت دار۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نام انبیاء اور صحابہ کرام کے زمانے سے منسلک ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ جو شخص بلند مرتبے اور عظیم مقام کا حامل ہو، اور اس کے پاس جاہ و منصب ہو

in_hindi.name: अथाल
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च पद और सम्मान वाला, शरीफ और प्रतिष्ठित
in_hindi.long_meaning: अथाल (Athaal) एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है उच्च पद और सम्मान वाला, शरीफ और प्रतिष्ठित। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत अधिक है क्योंकि यह नाम प्रोप्हेट्स और सहाबा के समय से जुड़ा हुआ है। इसका अर्थ है कि जो व्यक्ति उच्च पद और महान स्थान का धारक हो, और उसके पास सम्मान और गरिमा हो

in_english.name: Athaal
in_english.meaning: one who holds high rank and dignity, noble and esteemed
in_english.long_meaning: Athaal is an Arabic name that means one who holds high rank and dignity, noble and esteemed. The name Athaal has its roots in the Arabic language and is derived from the root 'A-Th-L', which means 'to be heavy or strong'. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with individuals of high moral character, nobility, and dignity. The name Athaal is mentioned in various Islamic texts and is considered a name of great significance and virtue. It symbolizes strength, resilience, and nobility of character

data.cultural_impact: The name Athaal, meaning a lion, is a source of inspiration and pride for many Muslims, particularly those who value courage and strength. In Islamic culture, the lion is often seen as a symbol of valor and bravery. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger." (Bukhari and Muslim) This hadith emphasizes the significance of self-control and courage, qualities that a lion embodies. Furthermore, the lion’s image is commonly used in Islamic art and calligraphy, adding to the name's cultural significance.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the name Athaal holds deeper spiritual significance. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is also reported to have said, "Whoever seeks Allah's pleasure, Allah will make him pleasurable to people." (Bukhari) By giving their child the name Athaal, parents may be instilling in them the desire to seek Allah's pleasure and embody the courage and strength of a lion. Additionally, the lion represents the natural world that Muslims believe is a sign of Allah's power and creation. Thus, the name Athaal can serve as a constant reminder of Allah's greatness and the importance of striving to live a life pleasing to Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lion" symbolizes A lion, a symbol of courage, power and strength. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Athaal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lion.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Athaal was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Athaal carried significant weight in that era.
